name: Monanaun
text: Monanaun is an anglicized spelling, drawn from Hiberno-Irish oral tradition, of the sea god Manannán mac Lir.

attributes.attribute: anglicized form, from Hiberno-Irish oral tradition, of Manannán mac Lir
oral-tradition form of the sea god's name

okr.objective: Documents Monanaun as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Monanaun renders Manannán mac Lir in English letters.
The form comes out of Hiberno-Irish oral telling.
Manannán mac Lir is the sea god of the tradition.
